item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use a deep midnight blue and charcoal ground, cut through by restless strokes of vermilion, bright coral, electric teal, and pale gold. Layer dense, dry-brushed bands with translucent washes, scraped pigment, soft blooms, and fine splatters. Let the marks gather into a turbulent knot just off center, then loosen into long, uneven gestures that pull toward the edges. Set sharp, high-contrast strokes against broad areas of quiet, nearly empty dark color; make the composition feel alert, searching, and unresolved through shifting rhythm and spatial tension. Emphasize tactile paint texture, varied stroke weight, and visible layering. Keep every form purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square image with the painting; no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting."}
